items.item: Status uses a consistent vocabulary with text labels, not colour alone
items.evidence: All statuses carry text, but vocabulary is mixed: header badge #statusBadge 'Pending your approval' (later 'Awaiting Level 3', 'Rejected') vs step labels in stepStyle 'Awaiting decision' / 'Not yet reached' / 'Skipped' / 'Approved'. Pending vs Awaiting for the same state.

items.item: Approval steps show approver, decision and absolute timestamp for each level
items.evidence: renderSteps(): 'Level 1: Direct Manager', 'Marcus Lee', 'Approved · Oct 29, 09:14' plus comment. Level 2/3 have no decision yet so no timestamp. Timestamps lack year and timezone.

items.item: Approve is the single primary action; Reject is secondary and requires a reason
items.evidence: #approveBtn solid emerald fill; #rejectBtn white with red outline; openModal('reject') blocks when comment empty and shows #commentErr 'Please explain why you are rejecting this request.' Audit flags Approve contrast 3.77:1 (minor).

items.item: Only the current approver can act; other users see why they cannot
items.evidence: Page is hardcoded as Dana Whitfield (Level 2). There is no non-approver state or message explaining why actions are unavailable; only a post-decision 'Decision recorded. No further action is needed from you.'

items.item: Amounts are prominent, right-aligned in line items and formatted as currency
items.evidence: #grandTotal text-3xl '$3,629.75'; Amount column th/td text-right tabular-nums via fmt() toLocaleString currency USD; audit numericCells misaligned 0.

items.item: Attachments are listed with name, type and size and can be previewed or downloaded
items.evidence: List shows name, type chip (PDF/DOC/IMG) and size, but Preview button only calls showAlert('Preview ... is not available in this demo.') and Download is <a href="#" onclick="return false">; neither works.

items.item: A history timeline records every action on the request
items.evidence: #activity ol via renderActivity(): submitted, Level 1 approved, routed to Finance Manager; confirm handler pushes approve/reject and routing entries with who, what, time and note. Timestamps lack year.

notes: tracked-uppercase-labels: 'TOTAL REQUESTED' and table headers use uppercase tracking-wide. rainbow-status: attachment type chips use red/blue/emerald plus amber/indigo/emerald elsewhere, mild. Otherwise clean: no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles, hover-lift or oversized radius. Initials avatar 'DW' is a real person so not flagged. Audit score 90, only violation Approve button contrast 3.77:1. Approval vs rejection flow works end to end with confirm dialog.
